founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
2x YC Founder. Building Adentris to bring AI-driven systems into healthcare operations - a personal mission inspired by the legacy of my fully medical family. As a mathematician, I bring a data-driven, systems approach to product development and GTM strategy.

Previously, I led ElectroNeek (W20) as CEO, scaling it to ~$5M ARR. Built a global B2B distribution and partnership network across 30+ countries (North & South America, Europe, Asia), and disrupted the RPA market with a novel GTM playbook.
